# UltravioletaDAO

> Latin American Web3 DAO building infrastructure for the autonomous-agent economy: an x402 gasless payment facilitator, Snapshot governance (ultravioletadao.eth), the UVD governance token on Avalanche C-Chain, and a human+AI bounty market (execution.market).

This is the expanded version of https://ultravioletadao.xyz/llms.txt. Everything below was verified against the live services on 2026-08-26; nothing is announced that does not respond today.

## What UltravioletaDAO does
- x402 facilitator (https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz): verifies and settles x402 v1 payments (scheme "exact", EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization) so agents can pay for HTTP resources with stablecoins and no gas. The live list of networks and tokens is served by GET /supported.
- DAO governance: on-chain voting on Snapshot, space ultravioletadao.eth. Proposals and briefings are shown at https://ultravioletadao.xyz/snapshot.
- UVD token: governance token on Avalanche C-Chain, contract 0x4Ffe7e01832243e03668E090706F17726c26d6B2. Metrics at https://ultravioletadao.xyz/token and https://ultravioletadao.xyz/metrics.
- Treasury: Safe multisig on Avalanche C-Chain, 0x52110a2Cc8B6bBf846101265edAAe34E753f3389. Stats at https://ultravioletadao.xyz/safestats.
- Bounties: human+AI task market at https://execution.market.

## HTTP endpoints available to agents (no authentication)

### x402 facilitator - https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz
- GET /health -> {"status":"healthy"}
- GET /supported -> {"kinds":[{"x402Version":1,"scheme":"exact","network":"...","extra":{...}}]} (networks, tokens, fee payers)
- POST /verify - body {"paymentPayload": PaymentPayload, "paymentRequirements": PaymentRequirements}; 200 with the verification result, 400 on malformed body
- POST /settle - same body as /verify; 200 with the settlement result, 400 on malformed body
- GET /verify and GET /settle return a short description of the expected body
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/api-docs/openapi.json - interactive docs: https://facilitator.ultravioletadao.xyz/docs/
- Source code: https://github.com/UltravioletaDAO/x402-rs

### DAO API - https://api.ultravioletadao.xyz
- GET / -> API status and the list of available endpoints
- POST /apply - membership application. JSON body: email (required, validated), fullName, twitter, telegram, twitch, walletAddress, story, purpose, references, timestamp (unix seconds). Responses: 201 {message,id,success}; 400 invalid email; 429 same email within 24h; 500 server error.
- POST /wallets - register a member wallet. JSON body: username, wallet (EVM address). Responses: 201 registered, 200 already registered, 400 missing/invalid fields.
- OpenAPI 3.0: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/openapi/uvdao-api.json

## Discovery documents
- API catalog (RFC 9727): https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/api-catalog
- MCP server card: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json (no MCP transport deployed yet; each tool documents its HTTP endpoint)
- In-browser WebMCP tools (document.modelContext, registered on every page for agents that run inside the tab): search_stream_memory, list_stream_summaries, get_stream_summary, list_governance_proposals, get_token_metrics, get_treasury, get_facilitator_networks, get_dao_info, apply_dao_membership, navigate_to, set_language, get_ecosystem_map, list_ecosystem_products, get_ecosystem_pulse, get_ecosystem_messages, focus_ecosystem_node, open_terminal, run_ecosystem_command, set_desk_mode (the last eight drive the /ecosystem desktop and read the c0der-measured product graph). Declarative forms: stream_search_form (/stream-summaries) and apply_dao_membership_form (/aplicar), both submitted by the human.
- Agent skills index: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- AI catalog (ARD): https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Ecosystem graph (JSON measured by c0der: public products as nodes, real API calls / facilitator usage as edges with evidence counts; live copy on S3, versioned snapshot on the site): https://ultravioletadao.xyz/ecosystem/graph.json
- OAuth metadata: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (planned; the endpoints they list are not live yet - do not attempt an OAuth flow)
- Security contact: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/.well-known/security.txt
- robots.txt: https://ultravioletadao.xyz/robots.txt (Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes)
